unit.why: A single anecdote, quoted from Tiferet Shlomo, in which the Besht presses R. Michel to accept a rabbinate, threatens him, and then reveals that it was a test of his humility.

stories.start_quote: כמו שנודע המעשה מהבעש״ט זי״ע שפ״א
stories.end_quote: לדעת את אשר בלבבך להטיבך באחריתך
stories.summary_en: The Besht urges his disciple R. Michel to accept a town's rabbinate and threatens that he will lose both worlds if he refuses; Michel refuses anyway, and the Besht blesses him and explains that he only meant to test whether Michel's spirit would grow proud.

quotes: כאשר לא התנשא רוחך ולבך על כל דברי אלה

tags.why: the tale illustrates the disciple's humility

quotes: באחד מגדולי תלמידיו הוא הצה״ק ר' מיכל

tags.why: the Besht shows anger, even if it is feigned

quotes: מ״מ לא אקבל שררות הרבנות עלי

pride is the failing being tested for
